source.title: Problems and conjectures in the qualitative theory of planar autonomous differential systems

trace.notes: Input normalized as a zbMATH resolver URL. The zbMATH REST API record for document 1436455 identified the work as Yan Qian Ye, Problems and conjectures in the qualitative theory of planar autonomous differential systems, in International conference on differential equations, EQUADIFF 91, pages 983-987, World Scientific, 1993, with zbMATH identifier 0938.34517. The zbMATH record exposed no full-text links and its editorial text stated that web interface contents were unavailable due to conflicting licenses.

Failure mode: metadata_only. The supplied zbMATH page was treated as a bibliographic resolver, not as a technical source. No readable PDF or HTML body containing the problem statements was available from the resolver metadata.

Bounded exact-work recovery attempted: exact-title web search, exact title plus PDF search, exact title plus author search, Crossref title query, and OpenAlex exact-title/search queries. Crossref and OpenAlex candidates were different works or broad topical matches; exact-title web results did not provide a confirmed readable copy of the same 1993 conference article. No extraction was performed from metadata, abstracts, snippets, or related works.
Saved final JSON to outputs/parse-paper/1436455.json and outputs/latest.json.
